fact: Chapter 4 is titled 'Your Mind Is The Seat Of Wisdom'
Wisdom is the correct application of knowledge
Wisdom is the last step in the thinking process, after which action follows
In the healing illustration, Knowledge says 'Surely He has borne my sicknesses and carried my pains. Himself took my infirmity and bore my diseases, and by His stripes, I was healed'
In the healing illustration, Understanding says 'If He has already borne your sicknesses, then you're not sick!'
In the healing illustration, Wisdom says 'If you're not sick, then stop feeling sick! Stop looking and acting sick, if you must ever get well'
A lot of people know that He took their infirmity, but they are still sick
What wisdom does is to dictate the steps to be taken that will help you draw out the benefits that knowledge delivered to you
The three-part summary: knowledge delivers the existence of the provision, understanding helps you to see the reality of that provision, and wisdom helps you to enjoy its benefits
All these stages are functions of the mind: the mind is where knowledge is acquired, it is the place of understanding, and also the seat of wisdom
2 Corinthians 8:9 is quoted: 'though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich'
On prosperity, Understanding says it takes a covenant walk to come out of poverty, the covenant being that seedtime and harvest shall not cease, functioning through a giving lifestyle
You may give and give and yet not get anything, so wisdom tells you the steps to take in order to experience the reality of prosperity
Wisdom says you are not only called upon to give, but also to create avenues through which God's blessings in response to your giving will get to you
Psalm 1:3 is cited, 'And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper', as the reason you must work with your hands to create channels for God's blessings to flow back
Divine wisdom is able to cut down to one year a journey that would have taken ten years
Divine wisdom guarantees the flow of divine ideas, which is your guarantee for a unique placement in life
When you operate with an idea from heaven you are bound to command a heavenly kind of results
When God touched the author's mentality the touch was so intense and profound that he exclaimed 'Lord, I'm understanding this thing too much!'
Romans 11:33 is quoted: 'O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!'
Most of the big brains on the international scene today are not committed Christians, they are just free-lance natural Christians, but the author sees the Church taking over
Job 28:7-18 is quoted on the reality of divine wisdom, opening 'There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen'
Job 28 says wisdom cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof, and that the price of wisdom is above rubies
Those who operate in this wisdom do not live with obstacles; it guarantees unending triumphs and a continuous humiliation of obstacles, because of the higher insight it offers
Divine wisdom has an unlimited ability to deliver results notwithstanding the conditions, and can generate a bumper harvest in famine, cited as Genesis 26:1-12
With divine wisdom you can beat any sinner to it, because you are in absolute and perfect command
Pharaoh literally surrendered his throne to the display of Joseph's divine wisdom, cited as Genesis 41:38-46
Divine wisdom delivers peace because it can see trouble far ahead of time and take steps to deal with it, so while the trouble is still preparing to trouble you, you have dealt with it

Divine wisdom naturally announces its carrier: in Solomon's time people came from far and near to hear his wisdom, and during Jesus' earthly ministry His fame spread abroad by reason of the divine wisdom He operated in
The wisdom of God at work in Joseph announced him too: while he was still in prison he was announced in the palace
The New Testament calls supernatural wisdom the wisdom of God, cited as 1 Corinthians 2:7, and it is His ordained device for making us stand out in the crowd
This kind of wisdom has never been seen or heard of, and God only reveals it by His Spirit, cited as 1 Corinthians 2:10
Divine wisdom is the heritage of all who are redeemed, cited as Matthew 11:19, and it is available, accessible, can be operated, and always stands clearly above all other levels of wisdom
James identifies FOUR kinds of wisdom, cited as James 3:15
The first kind is earthly wisdom, that is common sense, which you are born with; an example is how to eat, which you do not have to go to school to acquire
The second kind is sensual wisdom, which has to do with the intellect and can also be called intellectual wisdom
The third kind is devilish wisdom, the wisdom diabolical people and occultic forces operate in
The fourth kind is wisdom from above, which is far above the other forms of wisdom
Daniel chapter 2 is the demonstration of wisdom from above: in the second year of his reign Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him
Nebuchadnezzar commanded to call the magicians, the astrologers, the sorcerers and the Chaldeans to show the king his dreams

The Chaldeans answered that there is not a man upon the earth that can show the king's matter, and that it is a rare thing the king requireth, which none can show except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh
Daniel went in and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would show the king the interpretation
Daniel's answer that establishes the supremacy of divine wisdom is 'But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days'

Paul said this wisdom is not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought, cited as 1 Corinthians 2:6, meaning that side by side with divine wisdom those other levels equal zero
Divine wisdom is not earthly, it is not intellectual, neither is it diabolical
When Daniel operated this wisdom he stood far above the astrologers, magicians and sorcerers of his time
You have access to greater secrets than any philosopher, witch or intellectual, and you are not to operate in the realm of common sense because you belong to a heavenly order

The declaration to make is 'I am connected to the highest order of wisdom, I cannot afford to be stranded on the earth. What I operate with is from above, so my results should be clearly above what operates here on earth'
Daniel was so full of divine wisdom that he could lord it over all the philosophers, sorcerers and astrologers, and he simply stood out
Daniel 1:17 is quoted: 'As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams'
The wisdom that operated in Daniel had its source in God, who is the true source of wisdom
Job 28:20 asks 'Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?'
Divine wisdom is available and obtainable only from God; you cannot get it from the market no matter how much money you have
Anything extraordinary must have an extraordinary source, because like begets like

The author distinguishes three things: common sense, which is common to everybody; intellectual sense, which can be acquired with money by going to school; and heaven's sense, which is what he is talking about
1 Kings 4:29-31 says God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore
Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt
Solomon was wiser than all men, than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol, and his fame was in all nations round about
Solomon's wisdom was before the Holy Ghost came fully on the earth, and Jesus told us that a greater than Solomon is here

Jesus said the greatest of all born of woman is John the Baptist, but that the least in the kingdom of heaven is still greater than him, so John was greater than Solomon and you are by implication greater than both, because you are under a better covenant
Divine wisdom commands practical proofs: when it operated in Joseph it promoted him and caused him to enjoy upliftment, enlargement, peace, pleasantness and liberty
Divine wisdom is not rhetoric, it is practical, and God is its source
There are FOUR fundamental requirements for flowing in divine wisdom: salvation, the fear of God, meekness, and the Holy Spirit
Salvation is the first requirement, because divine wisdom is limited to the redeemed of the Lord, and Jesus said 'Wisdom is justified of her children', cited as Matthew 11:19
The fear of God is the second requirement, described as living to please Him
Proverbs 1:7 says 'The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction'
Proverbs 9:10 says 'The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding'
Daniel 1:8 tells us that Daniel purposed in his heart not to defile himself, because he was out to please God
The fear of God is NOT living in dread and trembling when you hear of God; it is living to please God as a lifestyle, living unto His pleasure, thus fulfilling your purpose for existence
Joseph lived in the fear of God, and said in Genesis 42:18 'For I fear God'
Job 28:28 says 'Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding'
The price for this wisdom is the fear of the Lord; it is the beginning and the end of wisdom, the only way both to get and to retain wisdom
Divine wisdom is not obtainable from schools, neither is it available in certificates; it demands the fear of the Lord as a lifestyle

The two men noted in scripture for divine wisdom are Joseph and Daniel, and both lived a lifestyle of fear and reverence for the Lord, so they not only operated in the wisdom of God, they sustained it
The fear of the Lord is called the author and finisher of divine wisdom, being not only the beginning of wisdom but also the end of it
Paul said in 1 Thessalonians 2:10 'Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblamably we have behaved ourselves among you all that believed'
Peter acknowledged that Paul's wisdom was in a class of its own, cited as 2 Peter 3:15-16
Paul said in Acts 24:16 'And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men'
An established fear of God is at the root of divine wisdom
Meekness is the third requirement, and Psalm 25:9 says 'The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way'
Meekness is required to get anything from God

Ahitophel had so much wisdom that all the counsel he gave were as though they were directly from God and were always accepted, but when one day his counsel was rejected he hung himself, cited as 2 Samuel 17:23
The flow of divine wisdom stops where meekness stops
Jeremiah 9:23 says 'Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches'
Daniel 2:30 records Daniel admitting the secret was not revealed to him for any wisdom that he had more than any living, but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king
Divine wisdom will not stop flowing as long as you acknowledge its source

The Holy Spirit is the fourth requirement, and you must continually bank on His help to enhance your flow in divine wisdom, because He came from heaven to represent heaven's wisdom in our mortal being
